Anonymous objects get an anonymous_<Supertype> symbol, own their members (no more misattribution to the enclosing class), and reference their implemented type.

decisions.question: companion object {} is anonymous (no name); contents emit with owner = enclosing class (probe-verified). Recommend: declared limitation — no symbol for the anonymous companion itself.
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: companion object {} is anonymous (no name); contents emit with owner = the enclosing class (probe-verified, 2026-08-27). Companion members are the class's static surface, so the attribution is semantically correct; no symbol for the anonymous companion itself.

decisions.question: Property accessors (get()/set()) are not separate symbols. Recommend: internal_silent (accessors are property parts).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL_SILENT: property accessors (get()/set()) are parts of the property symbol, not separate declarations.

decisions.question: val (a, b) = pair locals are not symbols. Recommend: internal_silent (no local symbols by design).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL_SILENT: destructuring locals are not symbols by design (no local-variable symbols in the kotlin analyzer).

decisions.question: Anonymous functions / lambdas are expressions, not declarations. Recommend: internal_silent (calls inside ARE captured — probe-verified).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL_SILENT: anonymous functions/lambdas are expressions; calls inside ARE captured (probe-verified, 2026-08-27) — the object_literal case (K6) now attributes their members correctly when the lambda is an anonymous-object body.

decisions.question: exports relationship kind: NOT EMITTED for kotlin (exports array is symbol-level ExportInfo). Recommend: declared limitation (like groovy S3).
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: the exports relationship kind is NOT EMITTED for kotlin; exports is a symbol-level ExportInfo array (matching groovy S3).

decisions.question: Modifier node types are consumed by extractModifiers/extractVisibility. Recommend: internal_silent (modifiers are payloads, not emissions) — visibility flows probe-verified.
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL_SILENT: modifier node types are consumed by extractModifiers/extractVisibility as payloads, not emissions; visibility payload is now fixture-pinned (kotlin/visibility-payload).
